  "scores": {
    "architecture": 9,
    "behavior": 8,
    "authority_security": 7,
    "validation": 6,
    "overall": 7
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "C25-F1 — crates/xtask/src/live_academy.rs:353 and the L13 special-action paths bypass the declared consumption guard. Calls reach Desk::academy without Guard::spend; settle merely reads the counters. All supplied L12/L13 receipts still report calls.used=0 after execution. A zero/exhausted calls budget therefore does not prevent dispatch. Charge the approved call/assessment budgets durably before the corresponding remote operations, including applicable non-program paths, and stop with an explicit budget outcome when unavailable. Acceptance: fixture runs with zero budget send no covered request, cap exhaustion blocks the next request, cumulative reruns cannot refill the cap, and receipts/consumption.jsonl reflect actual admitted spend. No actual over-budget assessment is established by this review.",
    "C25-F2 — crates/xtask/src/live_academy.rs:223, :357 and crates/xtask/src/ledger.rs:181 over-credit workflow coverage. Every L13 call is attributed to W52/W53/W54/W65/W66 and passes solely on result.kind=data; consequently settings.get and exam.eligibility contribute to a live-passed course-reset row without executing a reset. L12 similarly credits multiple learning workflows from arbitrary configured calls. The supplied program has no lab/progress submission receipt, exam/practical flow, Shift/Daily Incident flow or course-reset/certificate-preservation check. Replace blanket family-to-row credit with explicit required operation/assertion coverage and record redacted hosted outcomes/readbacks. Keep missing operations blocked unless an actual recorded owner reduction covers them. Acceptance: settings.get alone cannot close W53/W65/W66, generic data without the required grading/state assertions cannot close hosted grading, and every remaining required operation has its own justified live evidence.",
    "C25-F3 — docs/architecture/checks.json C25 records only the controlled_live test target. Its 13 tests validate manifests; the new xtask live_run integration suite and the changed desktop-core runtime_changes, dlp_subset and gateway_inference integration targets are absent from the recorded final test plan. Their source code and compilation are not executed assertion evidence. Add the affected production-interface suites to the reproducible C25 plan and run them against the final pinned inputs, including scm-sdk 0.2.4 and the budget/coverage regressions above. Supply actual logs/results and rerun any further consumers reached by the fixes.",
    "C25-F4 — crates/xtask/src/live_run.rs CheckReceipt/RunRecord bind only the private execution-manifest hash, not the executed implementation, dependency/build inputs or runner binary. The packet explicitly carries L11-L14/L17 results from earlier trees and before the SDK upgrade, but provides no verifiable old-input binding or narrow carry-forward comparison. Bind live runs and their receipts to immutable executed source/dependency/build/runner inputs and the approved scope version, without secret values. Requalify affected paths on the final candidate, or preserve the old executed inputs and provide a verifiable unaffected-path mapping. Acceptance: a passing receipt from another source/SDK cannot silently satisfy the current candidate, and the reviewer can assess every retained receipt's provenance without credentials."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "C25-B1 — Required L16 has no live receipts and is blocked-by-access in live-scope.json; W42-W45 remain required. L17-approved-read-call, L17-denied-call and L17-refresh are only native-app-required placeholders. Moving execution to a signed C26 app is not passing C25 evidence. D052/D053 do not withdraw these checks. Supply the designated native live scope/evidence, or obtain and record an explicit owner-approved scope/ordering amendment and revised review before treating C25 as complete.",
    "C25-B2 — live/reconciliation.jsonl retains the inactive airs-v2-c25-profile with unknown ID as open, including the later console/API search. New successful runs do not close that earlier resource. Its omission from lists does not establish absence or cleanup. Complete reconciliation/cleanup with evidence, or record an explicit owner-approved change to the cleanup obligation. The current record does neither."
  ],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "C25-G1 — The remaining required Harness/MCP native interactions in C25-B1 are unrun. C25's four native checks exercise synthetic filtering-profile, inactive-profile warning, Academy UUID sign-in and change-review keyboard behavior; they do not provide the missing real Harness conversation/SSO/history/proposal or MCP approve/deny/refresh evidence.",

D053 withdraws account-switch/access-change cases, not the other hosted learning, assessment, reset and incident workflows.",
    "C25-G3 — The final selected test run records 13 manifest tests only, and current live receipt types lack executed-code bindings. The missing integration execution and retained browser-dependent receipt provenance are C25-F3/F4. A frozen review packet binds the supplied receipt files, but does not establish which implementation produced them."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Independent read-only review. No application/source changes, builds, test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. Only this verdict is written. Assessed source, actual test definitions and recorded public/redacted evidence; runtime findings are not new reproductions. The private execution manifest and credential values were not read.",
    "All four supplied fingerprints independently match. Verified 754 source-inventory entries, 387 direct packet references, command logs/artifacts, shared dependency equivalence and exact C25 plans: 13 check/setup commands, 3 test/setup commands and 3 native-preparation commands. Both direct predecessors pass at 9; 33 transitive receipt bindings verify.",
    "The live runner uses the production Core and authority intents with scoped adapters, explicit confirmations, a reusable durable consumption guard and redacted receipts. Production fixes remain localized: deployment auth-code lookup, DLP normalization/deleted-item handling, Academy UUID identity validation and Gateway request shaping. These support the architecture score; the concrete budget and qualification gaps above prevent acceptance.",
    "Recorded checks include 425 desktop frontend tests, 224 core unit tests and 13 controlled-live manifest tests. All four registered C25 native checks report pass on executable 1266b95a5e6663610b9375bcc77d681f46cc4a14383a676c24b994ec1f3bc637. They do not close the other gaps above.",
    "Recorded consumption shows L01 scans 12, L18 scans 13 and L09 runs 36; the token ledger totals 87 across spend/report records. The supplied caps/delegated L18 adjustment are reported in the scope findings. L12/L13 consumption remains uncharged, so this review cannot attest to complete budget enforcement.",
    "The unavailable inactive profile is reported as inactive and unused, but its identity/state and cleanup remain unverified. No endpoint was called to investigate it. Other reconciliation entries report closure; their sanitized records were inspected, not independently repeated against the services.",
    "The cached Gateway answer without finish_reason is deliberately reported as invalid and retained as an SDK follow-up; the successful L09 qualification uses unique prompts and establishes uncached inference only. Native screenshots/AX evidence do not establish spoken VoiceOver. Real v1/login-Keychain, signed Harness/package, notarization and installed-artifact qualification are not established by this packet; C26 and the cumulative P08 review remain separate gates."
  ],
